label: Automated opinion. Research signal. Not investment advice.
min_age_days_note: assumption: 90 days is long enough for first citations to show. Test: plot citations vs age for 200 papers per field and pick the age where 80% have at least 1.

field_average_citations_per_month.note: assumption: placeholders. Test: sample 200 same-field papers aged 6 to 12 months from OpenAlex and use the mean.

components.title: Citations per month vs field average
Code or data released
components.formula: code released = 10, dataset released = 5, promised only = 0 (cap 15)

components.title: Industry co-authors
components.formula: none = 0, at least 1 = 8, at least 25% of authors = 15

components.title: Funder type (stated in the paper)
components.formula: government or nonprofit = 10, industry = 6, none stated = not counted

components.title: Readiness cues found in the paper
components.formula: 3 points per cue from a closed list, up to 5 cues. Each cue needs a source locator.

excluded_signals: anything an author or creator can edit (bio, website, self-reported traction)
